english.title: False statement to obtain prisoner custody officer certificate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of obtaining a certificate for **(..SPECIFY 'YOURSELF' OR NAME OTHER PERSON..) certifying that

(A)_[you]_
(B)_[he]_
(C)_[she]_

had been approved by the Secretary of State for the purpose of performing

(D)_[escort functions]_
(E)_[custodial duties]_
(F)_[escort functions and custodial duties]_

and that

(G)_[you were]_
(H)_[he was]_
(I)_[she was]_

authorised to perform them, made a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY MATERIAL..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 89(2) of and paragraph 5 of Schedule 10 to the Criminal Justice Act 1991.
